name: Java Shack
notes: 3 photos, all printed menu posters (Java Shack drink menu, an Acai/Egg Bites/Paninis/Bagels/Pastries poster, and a seasonal 'Fall is Here' poster), no prices printed anywhere. Photo 2 shows the same two main posters later with hand edits (a 'Breakfast Bowl' item crossed out entirely, a 'Hand menus available at window' sign taped above) so that item is omitted; photo 3 duplicates the Acai/Bagels/Pastries poster and was merged, not double-counted. Flavor/variant lists (bagel flavors, croissant/danish/scone/muffin types) were kept as one dish per category with the variants in the description rather than one dish per flavor.
